entries.title: AMID EVIL
entries.definitive_edition: AMID EVIL on Windows PC with The Black Labyrinth DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with current updates and DLC.

primary.version: Current PC release with The Black Labyrinth DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the definitive route because AMID EVIL is sourced as a Windows PC release, the PC version has the full base campaign plus the Black Labyrinth prequel expansion DLC, and no shipped non-PC flat-screen port with exclusive content is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy AMID EVIL on Steam or GOG for Windows PC, install the current build, and add The Black Labyrinth DLC for the complete campaign/expansion route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Black Labyrinth is an expansion/prequel DLC, not a separate port; AMID EVIL VR is a separate VR rebuild and is tracked as its own entry.

entries.title: AMID EVIL VR
entries.definitive_edition: AMID EVIL VR on Windows PC VR

emulation.notes: Use the native SteamVR release with a supported headset; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC VR headset and GPU dependent.

primary.why: The SteamVR/Windows PC VR version is the best route for the VR rebuild because it targets PC VR hardware with a higher fidelity ceiling, while the Quest release is valuable for standalone play but does not have exclusive content over PC VR.
primary.how_to_play: Buy AMID EVIL VR on Steam for Windows PC and play through a supported PC VR headset such as Valve Index, Meta Quest via PC VR, HTC Vive, or Rift S.

entries.remaster_caveats: AMID EVIL VR is a separate VR rebuild of the base game, distinct from the flat-screen AMID EVIL release.
